preconditions.description: The length of the sequences a and b is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The boundaries of the segment where the elements of sequences a and b are between 1 and 10^9 inclusive, and l is less than or equal to r.

preconditions.expression: all(l <= a_i <= r for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element of the sequence a is between l and r inclusive.
The length of the sequence a is n.
The length of the compressed sequence p is n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each element of the compressed sequence p is between 1 and n inclusive.
All elements of the compressed sequence p are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value.split()) == n and all(l <= int(b_i) <= r for b_i in return_value.split()))
postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' or a sequence of n integers where each integer is between l and r inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the compressed sequence p is valid and contains integers between 1 and n inclusive.
If the output is not '-1', all elements of the compressed sequence p are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(1 <= c_i <= n for c_i in sorted(c))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the sorted sequence c contains integers between 1 and n inclusive.
If the output is not '-1', all elements of the sequence c are distinct.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(p_i == sum(1 for c_j in c if c_j <= c_i) for i, p_i in enumerate(p, start=1))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the compressed sequence p correctly represents the sequence c.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or all(b_i == c_i + a_i for i, (b_i, c_i) in enumerate(zip(return_value.split(), c)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the sequence b is correctly calculated as c + a.
